proof_summary: Take \(n=18\): since \(\sigma(18)=39\), its reduced denominator is \(18/\gcd(18,39)=6\), while \(\sigma(6)=12\) gives reduced denominator \(1=2^0\), so \(6\) satisfies the required membership condition. But \(18\) does not, because its reduced denominator is \(6\), which is not a power of two.
